description: Content discovery scheduled task (step-01-discover.md) could not execute in Cowork session. Desktop Commander MCP is not loaded, and sandboxed bash environment lacks outbound network access for read.py Slack integration. Do not use it for this step. Use mcp__Desktop_Commander__start_process instead.'
correction: Task should run in native Jarvis (Claude Code) runtime where Desktop Commander is always available, OR Slack MCP connector must be pre-authorized and connected in this Cowork session.
